title: eriogonum caryophylloides
intro: Eriogonum caryophylloides, commonly known as Desert Buckwheat, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the southwestern regions of North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Desert Buckwheat include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activities. Bioactive constituents of Eriogonum caryophylloides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
